AgentQuestion.label: Checking can settle it
AgentQuestion.explain: An open question an agent can settle by reading, running or testing.

BrianQuestion.label: Brian's call
BrianQuestion.explain: A product or priority question; it carries a recommendation and a default.

Concept.label: Concept
Concept.explain: A domain-model concept; open the Domain model tab for its definition.

nodes.label: Q1: Rules retry never runs here
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether a world whose rules fail the part-way or liveness checks can be repaired on the live path, or only scored lower.

nodes.label: Q2: Losers of a race are not told
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether every world's run loop wastes most people's turns whenever one thing is contested, and whether residents can reason about losing.

nodes.label: Q3: Agenda item has no content
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether the group-decision family's agenda needs content or should be dropped.

nodes.label: Q4: Notice only as good as the words
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether E2 (a fix carries its substance) holds for every world or only when residents happen to write specific words.

nodes.label: Q5: People misread visible state
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether to change how state is shown to residents or leave it as model error.

nodes.label: Q6: One round run twice
nodes.explain: Blocks: wasted spend and shares that keep only one of two runs.

nodes.label: Q7: Losing hedge keeps running
nodes.explain: Blocks: about $0.03 per build and misleading calls in the build trace.

nodes.label: Q8: Rules check a resource but never claim it
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether a finished build is faithful to what was described.

nodes.label: Q9: Test run too short for some tasks
nodes.explain: Blocks: builds wrongly scored as failing and the rewrite spend they cause.

nodes.label: Q10: Retry keeps the first words
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether the transcript's words match the move that ran.

nodes.label: Q11: Memory seeded before delivery
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether beliefs can run ahead of what the world has shown a person.

nodes.label: Q12: When a people-world run ends
nodes.explain: Blocks: how long visitors watch a run, and its cost.

nodes.label: Q13: Which hardening first
nodes.explain: Blocks: the next goal.

nodes.label: Q14: Agent-harness build not live
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether build repairs come from a harness or from the rules retry (Q1).

nodes.label: Q17: Offline pipeline views
nodes.explain: Blocks: whether work goes into the offline pipeline at all.

nodes.label: Agenda count
nodes.explain: group_decision.agenda_items: a bare number of matters put before the decision; an item has no content.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.explain: Description to spec, actions, rules, assembly, scripted test run and score.

nodes.label: Concern
nodes.explain: An objection a group holds on a delivered item: open, under remedy or resolved, with answered and remedy_by.

nodes.label: Lost race
nodes.explain: When an earlier pick changed the state, a later pick is resubmitted or re-chosen once; if nothing is left the person gets nothing_left and is not told why.

nodes.label: Generated actions and rules
nodes.explain: The moves and processes the fixed parts do not cover, written by the rules-writing AI and compiled.

nodes.label: Group decision
nodes.explain: A decision with support, deadline, deployment and review; changed only by fixed rules.

nodes.label: Build in an agent harness
nodes.explain: Decision 008: worlds built by an agent that drafts, checks and edits; scripts/world_harness.py exists but the live service does not call it.

nodes.label: Information item
nodes.explain: A piece of information with a source and per-recipient deliveries; hidden until delivered.

nodes.label: Executable-law fingerprint
nodes.explain: Roadmap hardening item: fingerprint the exact executable law and compiler version.

nodes.label: Finished-task notice
nodes.explain: What the other people a finished task names are told, in the starter's own words about the work.

nodes.label: Resident
nodes.explain: One Concordia AI agent per person: sees its brief, memory and what it can see, answers belief, move, expected effect and work.

nodes.label: Rules retry
nodes.explain: A second rules attempt after a rejection or weak score; skipped after 80 s.

nodes.label: Run loop
nodes.explain: Each round: everyone decides, picks are submitted in a rotating order, then processes run.

nodes.label: Share link and replay
nodes.explain: A saved run rebuilt from the run log that a visitor replays with no AI calls.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.explain: A watched field value that takes several rounds, started by a person or the world, ended by a process: finished or failed part-way.

nodes.label: Scripted test run
nodes.explain: The build's free run with simple moves that scores the rules and lists long tasks and whether each can fail part-way.
